meaning:
1) slave, servant
1a) slave, servant, man-servant
1b) subjects
1c) servants, worshippers (of God)
1d) servant (in special sense as prophets, Levites etc)
1e) servant (of Israel)
1f) servant (as form of address between equals)
Aramaic equivalent: a.vad (עֲבַד "servant/slave" H5649)

renderings.kjv: But as for thee and thy servants
that ye should not be their bondmen
and he shall be thy servant
and ye shall be his servants
then will we be your servants
therefore he shall be my servant
even there also will thy servant
If thou wilt be a servant
nd yet thou hast not been as my servant
and that I am thy servant
here with you none of the servants
Nevertheless they shall be his servants
Moreover by them is thy servant
that thou shouldest be my servant
also unto you all my servants
